verdict.rationale: Clara's own marketing says it offers 'automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance' (clara-docs-21), so some approval workflow exists. Nothing in the evidence describes how approvals are structured, and the API docs cover cards, transactions, invoices and webhooks with no approval-workflow endpoints. missing for 10: configurable multi-step chains (manager → budget owner → finance), approver delegation, escalation or timeouts for stalled approvals, any first-party docs on approval routing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
